Wikipedia (Shlomo Cunin) also gives 1972; J. Rabbi Shmulie and Mushka Cunin now run Chabad at UCSD (this listing, made about 2022). Medium: the year is the campus Chabad's, and whether the Cunins' center counts as the same one is a judgment. (Wikipedia also speaks of a UC San Diego Chabad house in 1972.) Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 3737 Nobel Drive, San Diego (Rabbi Yehuda Hadjadj); it is now at 8506 Villa La Jolla Drive, so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found).
